operation_items.operation: apply the transition only to free occurrences
an inner binding masks the transition
reject the transition when it would change the binding relation
apply the transition where no binding shadows it
the declared free-variable invariant holds after the transition

prompt_intro: The crate builds, but `substitute` breaks the free-variable invariant: it substitutes inside a lambda that shadows the name, and it captures a replacement's free variable. Make it capture-avoiding: a shadowed binder makes the substitution a no-op, and a substitution that would capture a replacement variable returns `None` with the term unchanged. Keep the signature.
provenance: original; authored for SELVEDGE P12.9/P11.21 (S14), no public benchmark text

shared_operation.audit: author annotation only; no inter-annotator agreement yet (P11.21 gap)
shared_operation.definition: Given a declared state invariant, apply a transition to every component that carries the invariant, reject a transition that would violate it and leave the state unchanged, and never let a partial update escape.
shared_operation.name: invariant preservation
shared_operation.transfer_rule: A surface is solved only when every task on that surface passes; the trio win requires all three surfaces and is never pooled across them.
